authority: GLOSSARY.md (Output area, Execution area, Stage 2 report figure, Stage 2 acceptance evidence)

principles.rule: A recorded seal that code reads at runtime must be re-issued after any bound path moves; the superseded seal's bytes are preserved in log/historical/seals/ and the old-to-new binding is recorded here.
principles.why: bases/truth_successor.py:check_successor() resolves and hashes every recorded binding path and derives the truth directory from bindings.truth_manifest.path. Rewriting historical records is forbidden, so re-issue rather than edit.

principles.rule: Seals that bind only digests or bare names move without re-issue; their build CLIs reproduce them from explicit paths, and informational path strings stay as historical text.
principles.why: identity, native, shared, training, truth-v1 and HVG manifests contain no runtime-read paths, so moving payloads leaves every declared digest valid.

principles.rule: A rejected or superseded payload leaves output/ only after every accepted dependency is re-bound, a removal record names the old path and digest, and any compact failure evidence is retained.
principles.why: ADR 0062: candidate acceptance precedes replacement and cleanup; historical sealed records keep their bytes.

principles.rule: One artifact, one role: a payload that is published as a figure or plotted value exists once, under figure/, and the internal copy is an audit record in log/, not a second product.
principles.why: The diagnostic panel and its CSV are currently byte-identical duplicates of internal artifacts.

open_decisions.question: Where do the public reader and metric implementations live?
open_decisions.detail: ADR 0062 and stage2/AGENTS.md say public readers and metric implementations belong to the output contract and 'public implementations live here' (output/). The repository .gitignore ignores /stage2/01_bases/output/ as payload/checkpoint space and check_tracked.sh exists to fail when an ignore rule swallows code. The two rules cannot both be satisfied by a plain move. The modules in question are execution/bases/{identity,metrics,hvg,significance,truth_successor,plots,raw,corpora}.py and execution/bases/truth_build.py's R worker, currently imported by every CLI.

options.label: Move the public modules into stage2/01_bases/output/api/ (tracked, force-added) and add an explicit .gitignore exception for that subtree.
options.consequence: Literal ADR 0062. Splits the bases package across two trees, adds an ignore-rule exception inside a 34 GB payload tree, and makes check_tracked.sh the only guard against future silently-ignored modules.

options.label: Keep the implementation in execution/bases/ and publish only a sealed interface descriptor under output/ that names the modules and their digests.
options.consequence: No code moves and no ignore exception, but the ADR sentence 'public implementations live here' is only partly satisfied; a later reader still has to add execution/ to sys.path.

options.label: Keep the implementation tracked in execution/bases/ and declare that path the single public implementation in the step contract, adding a one-line ADR 0062 annotation that the placement means 'the single public implementation consumed by build and audit commands', not a directory name.
options.consequence: Cleanest for tracking integrity and zero code churn; requires an ADR-level decision, which is why #155 does not take it unilaterally.

open_decisions.recommendation: C, with A as the alternative if the literal placement is wanted. #155 records the options and does not move code.
open_decisions.blocks: #156 may start every other row; the public-implementation row is held until this is decided. Affects ADR 0062 wording if C is chosen.
